name: Five Signs It's Time to Replace Your Carpet
title-tag: When to Replace Carpet: 5 Honest Signs | Mercer Island
meta-description: Matting that won't recover, odor that survives cleaning, visible backing — five honest signs carpet is done, and the cases where a restretch saves it.
post-summary: December 24, 2026 · Five signs genuinely mean replacement: unrecoverable matting, odor below the carpet, visible backing, a dead pad, and age past cleaning's reach. Just as important is what is not on the list — ripples mean a restretch, and dirty-looking lanes are often just dirty. The tests we use at estimates, honestly.
